name: carousel-3d
title: Carousel 3D
description: A draggable carousel that places image cards around an invisible circle in 3D space, tilts the ring and turns it slowly. Dragging spins it; releasing resumes the auto-spin.
use: A portfolio or gallery wants to show many images as a browsable carousel with depth.
avoid: It pulls in Three.js and sizes cards in fixed pixels, so the ring crowds or clips on narrow screens.
a11y: Rotation is drag-only and endless, images have no alt text, and reduced-motion is not honoured. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Rectangular photo cards stand around an unseen circle on a black stage, each tilted and angled like a ring seen from slightly above. Cards near the middle face forward while edge cards turn away in perspective.
behaves: The whole ring turns slowly on its own. Pressing and dragging left or right spins it faster in that direction, and letting go restarts the steady rotation.
customise: items (image URLs), width, height, className and containerClassName are props; the ring radius and rotation speed are fixed in the source.
weight: heavy: A Three.js CSS3D render plus a continuous motion animation every frame.
demo: Mountain and landscape photos on the cards; heading Drag to rotate.
issues: Cards use fixed pixel sizes, so the ring can overflow a narrow container.
Images are painted as CSS backgrounds with no alt text.
polishWhy: Convincing depth and smooth spin; images lack alt text and the ring can overflow.
